newsitem.title: UK: Thames Water plans huge new reservoir - paper.
newsitem.headline: Thames Water plans huge new reservoir - paper.

text.p: Britain's Thames Water is drawing up plans for a new 800 million pound ($1.3 billion) reservoir, the Independent on Sunday said.

The newspaper reported that Thames had identified an area of low grade agricultural land where the four square-mile reservoir would be built as part of a long-term strategic programme for maintaining water supplies to its customers.
It said that without the reservoir, the company is concerned that the London and Thames region could face acute water shortages by early next century.
